integrity: Analytic proof uses stationary Gaussian joint laws and Cayley–Hamilton; standalone finite numerical diagnostics support the formulas but do not prove universal claims. No independent external audit or experimental validation is claimed.
limitations: Stationary, fully observed, two-dimensional OU diffusions with constant positive-definite diffusion and even-parity coordinates; exact distributional reversibility, not finite-sample statistical power. The two-clock assertion ensures only exact non-aliasing, without a uniform detection margin.
title: Exact stroboscopic reversibility and two-clock detection in planar Ornstein–Uhlenbeck diffusion
